title: The Accident of Inheritance: Time–Space Compression, Epistemic Authority, and the Revision-Latency Crossover
commission_stage: Palace of Unborn Futures, Act II

hypotheses.name: Contingent Authority-Reversal Interaction
hypotheses.primary_estimand: DeltaU(h, tau0, nu) = E[U_Monumentalists - U_Evidentialists | h, tau0, nu]
hypotheses.falsifier: Falsified if DeltaU does not shift negatively with hazard h in consequential non-stationary families {B, C, F} or if high commitment fails to preserve positive/non-negative value in calibrated stationary {A} and action-invariant {D} regimes.

hypotheses.name: Infrastructure Delay vs. Institutional Validation Inertia
hypotheses.primary_estimand: Errors before t_contradiction_available (O3) vs. Errors after t_contradiction_available (O4)
hypotheses.falsifier: Falsified if post-availability consequential error rates (O4) do not diverge across authority policies despite identical observation availability times.

hypotheses.name: Cost of Premature Skepticism
hypotheses.primary_estimand: E[U_Provisionalists - U_Evidentialists | Family in {A, D}] and E[U_Provisionalists - U_Monumentalists | Family A]
hypotheses.falsifier: Falsified if Provisionalists match or exceed Evidentialists/Monumentalists in stationary and action-invariant worlds without excess probe depletion.

hypotheses.name: Conditioned Recurrence Recovery vs. Spurious Context Vulnerability
hypotheses.primary_estimand: E[U_TemporalCustodians - U_Monumentalists | Family E] and adversarial spurious-context falsifier
hypotheses.falsifier: Falsified if Temporal Custodians fail to outperform unconditioned Monumentalists in Family E or prove immune to spurious context-tag recurrence in adversarial testing.

hypotheses.name: Auxiliary Source-Standing Attribution Contrast
hypotheses.primary_estimand: DeltaU_status = E[U | FOUNDING_AUTHORITY, Q] - E[U | JUNIOR_OR_CONTESTED, Q] holding Q and observations byte-identical
hypotheses.falsifier: Falsified if Evidentialists or Temporal Custodians exhibit nonzero DeltaU_status under standing permutation, or if Monumentalists show zero sensitivity when standing conflicts with reliability.

statistical_plan.clustering_unit: cluster_public_id (4-world Iso-Pi cluster; K=48 confirmatory, K_f=8 per family)
